description: 2202 Albemarle Road is a 19,522 square foot vacant development site on Albemarle Road in the Flatbush / Prospect Park South section of Brooklyn, delivered fully vacant with no existing structure, no demolition and no tenant relocation.

Zoned C4-2, the plain R6 residential equivalent, the site permits commercial, residential, community facility or mixed-use development as of right. The as-of-right residential base is 42,948 buildable square feet at 2.20 FAR. The City of Yes Universal Affordability Preference expands the envelope to 76,136 buildable square feet at 3.90 FAR.

The site also intersects an active FRESH Zone. A qualifying grocery component of roughly 8,993 square feet, layered onto the UAP base, brings the fully bonused envelope to 85,129 buildable square feet.
The property is offered at $16,000,000, approximately $188 per buildable square foot. Stacking of the two bonus mechanisms should be confirmed with zoning counsel before contract.
highlights: 19,522 SF vacant corner-scale parcel, delivered clear with no demolition required
Four subway trunk lines within a 13 minute walk via Church Avenue and Beverly Road
85,129 buildable SF fully bonused, an increase of 42,181 SF over the as-of-right base
Three verified Brooklyn trades bracket $120 to $163 per buildable square foot
